^@
vIOS4#
vIOS4#
vIOS4#configure terminal
Enter configuration commands, one per line.  End with CNTL/Z.
vIOS4(config)#no logging console
vIOS4(config)#no logging monitor
vIOS4(config)#router ospf 1
vIOS4(config-router)#router-id 4.4.4.4
vIOS4(config-router)#auto-cost reference-bandwidth 10000
% OSPF: Reference bandwidth is changed. 
        Please ensure reference bandwidth is consistent across all routers.
vIOS4(config-router)#network 10.10.1.8 0.0.0.3 area 0
vIOS4(config-router)#network 4.4.4.4 0.0.0.0 area 0
vIOS4(config-router)#no area 0 stub
vIOS4(config-router)#no area 0 nssa
vIOS4(config-router)#no default-information originate
vIOS4(config-router)#no passive-interface default
vIOS4(config-router)#exit
vIOS4(config)#logging console
vIOS4(config)#logging monitor
vIOS4(config)#logging console
vIOS4(config)#logging monitor
vIOS4(config)#end
vIOS4#
